stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.description: Send invoices, calculate tax, and collect payments using our native connector to Stripe.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} Stripe app enables invoicing, tax collection, and payment via Stripe.

stripeInvoicing.title: Stripe Invoicing
paragraphs: Create and send invoices through Stripe Invoicing directly from {{brandName}} and automatically collect payments.

automaticTax.title: Automatic Tax Calculations
paragraphs: Leverage Stripe Tax to handle complex tax rules and rates for any region. The integration ensures accurate, up-to-date tax calculations for each invoice, removing the guesswork and reducing compliance risks.

securePayments.title: Secure and Flexible Payments
paragraphs: Collect payments quickly and securely via Stripe's trusted payment gateway. Your customers can choose from various payment methods - credit card, ACH, and more - to improve the overall customer experience and speed up cash flow.

razorpay.name: Razorpay
razorpay.description: Accept, process and disburse payments using our native connector to Razorpay.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} Razorpay app enables invoicing, tax calculations, and payment collection directly through Razorpay. Integrate it seamlessly with {{brandName}} (or your billing engine) to streamline your payment workflows.

razorpayInvoicing.title: Razorpay Invoicing
paragraphs: Create and send invoices with a few clicks - right from {{brandName}} - using Razorpay's invoicing capabilities. Payment collection can be automated, reducing manual follow-ups.

automaticTax.title: Automatic Tax Calculations
paragraphs: Leverage Razorpay's support for regional tax rules (e.g., GST in India). This integration ensures accurate, up-to-date tax rates for each invoice, minimizing compliance risks and manual calculations.

securePayments.title: Secure and Flexible Payments
paragraphs: Collect payments quickly and securely via Razorpay's trusted payment gateway. Your customers can choose from various methods - credit cards, debit cards, net banking, UPI, and wallets - enhancing the payment experience and accelerating cash flow.

chargebee.name: Chargebee
chargebee.description: Sync invoices and charges/prices between {{brandName}} and Chargebee for seamless billing operations.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} Chargebee app enables seamless synchronization of invoices and charges/prices between {{brandName}} and Chargebee. Integrate it to streamline your billing workflows.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Sync invoices from {{brandName}} to Chargebee, ensuring your billing system stays up to date with the latest invoice data.

chargePriceSync.title: Charge and Price Sync
paragraphs: Synchronize charges and prices between {{brandName}} and Chargebee to maintain consistency across your billing platform.

hubspot.name: Hubspot
hubspot.description: Hubspot is a CRM, sales, marketing and customer service platform.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} HubSpot app enables seamless syncing of deals, invoices, customers, and payments between HubSpot and {{brandName}}.

dealLineItems.title: Deal Line Items Sync
paragraphs: Automatically sync deal line items from HubSpot to {{brandName}}, ensuring accurate revenue tracking and billing.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Push invoices from {{brandName}} to HubSpot to keep your CRM up to date with billing information.

customerSync.title: Customer Sync
paragraphs: Sync customer data between HubSpot and {{brandName}} to maintain a single source of truth for customer information.

paymentsSync.title: Payments Sync
paragraphs: Keep payment records synchronized between both platforms for accurate financial reporting.

revenueReporting.title: Revenue Calculations on HubSpot
paragraphs: Leverage HubSpot's reporting capabilities with accurate revenue data synced from {{brandName}}.

salesforce.description: Salesforce is a customer relationship management (CRM) platform.

paypal.description: PayPal is an online payment system that supports online money transfers.

zoho.description: The Zoho Books integration lets you manage critical accounting tasks directly from {{brandName}}.

createCustomer.title: Create Customer in Zoho Books
paragraphs: Automatically create or update customers in Zoho Books whenever a new customer is added or modified in {{brandName}}.

createInvoice.title: Create Invoice in Zoho Books
paragraphs: Generate Zoho Books invoices seamlessly from {{brandName}} usage data or billing triggers, reducing manual work.

transformInvoice.title: Transform {{brandName}} Invoice to Zoho Books Invoice
paragraphs: Convert a {{brandName}} invoice object into Zoho Books' invoice format - streamlining data flow and ensuring accuracy.

quickbooks.name: QuickBooks
quickbooks.description: Sync plans, customers, and invoices from {{brandName}} to QuickBooks Online for seamless accounting operations.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} QuickBooks integration enables one-way sync from {{brandName}} to QuickBooks Online. Automatically sync plans, customers, and invoices to keep your accounting system up to date.

planPriceSync.title: Plan/Price Sync
paragraphs: Automatically create QuickBooks Items (Service type) when plans are created in {{brandName}}. Each price is mapped to a QuickBooks Item for accurate invoice line items.

customerSync.title: Customer Sync
paragraphs: Customers are automatically created in QuickBooks when invoices are synced. Customer data including name, email, and billing address is synchronized.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Automatically sync invoices from {{brandName}} to QuickBooks Online. Invoice line items are mapped to QuickBooks Items, ensuring accurate accounting records.

tokenRefresh.title: Automatic Token Refresh
paragraphs: OAuth tokens are automatically refreshed by the backend when they expire, ensuring uninterrupted sync operations without manual intervention.

nomod.name: Nomod
nomod.description: Send invoices and collect payments using payment links through Nomod integration.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} Nomod app enables invoicing and payment collection through Nomod payment links. Integrate it seamlessly with {{brandName}} to streamline your payment workflows.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Create and send invoices with payment links through Nomod directly from {{brandName}}. Payment collection can be automated through Nomod payment links.

paymentLinks.title: Payment Links
paragraphs: Generate secure payment links for your invoices using Nomod. Your customers can pay quickly and securely through various payment methods supported by Nomod.

webhooks.title: Webhook Integration
paragraphs: Receive real-time notifications about invoice and payment link events through webhooks. Stay updated on payment status, invoice creation, and more.

moyasar.name: Moyasar
moyasar.description: Send invoices and collect payments using Moyasar payment gateway integration.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} Moyasar app enables invoicing and payment collection through Moyasar payment gateway. Integrate it seamlessly with {{brandName}} to streamline your payment workflows.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: Create and send invoices through Moyasar directly from {{brandName}}. Payment collection can be automated through Moyasar payment gateway.

securePayments.title: Secure Payments
paragraphs: Collect payments quickly and securely via Moyasar payment gateway. Your customers can choose from various payment methods to improve the overall customer experience and speed up cash flow.

webhooks.title: Webhook Integration
paragraphs: Receive real-time notifications about payment events through webhooks. Subscribe to payment_paid event to stay updated on payment status.

paddle.name: Paddle
paddle.description: Send invoices and collect payments using Paddle payment gateway integration.

overview.title: Overview

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync

securePayments.title: Secure Payments

webhooksPaddle.title: Webhook Integration

whop.name: Whop
whop.description: Sync invoices to Whop with automatic payment status updates.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The {{brandName}} Whop integration lets you push invoices directly to Whop as one-time send_invoice payments. Customers can pay via the Whop-hosted checkout page, and {{brandName}} is automatically updated when payment is received.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: When invoice sync is enabled, {{brandName}} automatically creates a corresponding invoice in Whop whenever a {{brandName}} invoice is finalized. The integration ensures your Whop product exists (creating one if needed).
You can also mark a Whop invoice as paid from {{brandName}}, which calls the Whop mark_paid API on your behalf.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
paragraphs: Register the {{brandName}} webhook URL in your Whop developer settings to receive invoice.paid events. When Whop fires this event, {{brandName}} automatically marks the corresponding invoice as paid and records the payment.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: Sync invoices to Tabs using your Tabs API key.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: The Flexprice Tabs integration lets you push invoices directly to Tabs using your Tabs API key. Configure a connection name, API key, and invoice sync settings to get started.

invoiceSync.title: Invoice Sync
paragraphs: When invoice sync is enabled, Flexprice automatically pushes finalized invoices to Tabs.

aws_marketplace.name: AWS Marketplace
aws_marketplace.description: Report metered usage to AWS Marketplace so your AWS buyers are billed for what they consume.

overview.title: Overview
paragraphs: Flexprice reports the usage you already meter to AWS Marketplace on your behalf. Connect the marketplace-metering IAM role from your own AWS account, and Flexprice takes care of sending BatchMeterUsage for each registered agreement.

setup.title: Setup
paragraphs: Create an IAM role in your AWS account using the IAM policy and trust policy shown in the connection panel. The trust policy grants Flexprice's AWS account permission to assume the role, scoped to a unique external ID. Paste the resulting Role ARN back into Flexprice and save — Flexprice verifies the role by assuming it before storing the connection.

usageReporting.title: Usage Reporting
paragraphs: Once connected, an hourly job aggregates usage per agreement and reports it to AWS via BatchMeterUsage, with a daily reconciliation pass as a backstop.
